note: The Six Lines demo walkthrough in Simplified Chinese (the English is walkthrough.json): music and burned-in text, no voice. The plan is series/critic/demo/review-2.md (changed timeline, 8/10). Rendered by `node scripts/demo.mjs`. Beats are at the music's tempo. A live shot plays a take under public/ from `from` seconds at `rate`; `zoom` and `focus` (0 top, 1 bottom) crop into the phone screen, and `place` puts the text at the top or bottom.

from.how: mobile-mcp screen recording; variable frame rate, converted with ffmpeg -vf fps=30,format=yuv420p -c:v libx264 -crf 16 for Remotion to seek it by time

take8.recorded: 2026-09-26, iPhone 17 Pro Max simulator (iOS 26.2), sixlines-ios b459a31f, Matrix skin, Simplified Chinese (-appLanguage zh-Hans), Gua on 8bitoracle-next f944b498 (PR #285: the proof section follows the locale, "…，则此解读有误"). Question typed, 18 entered by hand with no changing lines, one fresh Gua interpretation. Takes 4-7 were abandoned: 4 had hexagram 5 left over in the picker, 5 got the English proof section (before PR #285), 6 crashed the app (SavedReading read after deletion in JournalTab), 7 got take 5's saved reading back.

shots.text:
我要接手爸妈的店，
但生意越来越差。
该从哪里改起？

texts.text:
这个 App
不回答是或不是。

它给你一个处境，
让你想清楚。

shots.text:
解读把这一卦
落到你的店上。

王弼的注，
写于三世纪。

解读也写明：
怎样算它错了。

你来决定。
然后记下结果。
